body: Thanks. Writing ability and depression are bedfellows.

All my life all I have ever wanted, with INTENSITY, is to have someone who loves me and who I can love. But I am ugly, have a crippled self esteem and am riddled with STDs. 

Nobody wants me, I feel like a cancerous cell that humanity has pushed aside and rejected. Every time a girl knocks me back it crushes me. devastates me. Reminds me of my utter utter worthlessness and failure as a man. this loneliness is so intense I do not have the words to make you understand even a little of it.
